entities.name: EMM uplink message transmission failure
entities.description: Abnormal case where lower layers indicate failure in transmitting an EMM uplink message.

entities.name: UE implementation decision
entities.description: Condition where the UE implementation decides whether to rerun the ongoing procedure.

entities.name: Retransmission mechanism
entities.description: Mechanism to re-initiate the procedure by retransmitting the uplink message with new sequence number and MAC.

entities.name: Uplink message
entities.description: EMM message that failed transmission and may be retransmitted.

relations.description: EMM uplink message transmission failure triggers UE implementation decision on procedure rerun.
UE implementation decision may lead to using the retransmission mechanism.
Retransmission mechanism involves retransmitting the uplink message with new sequence number and MAC.
